Question Choices: A sinusoidal temperature model has maximum 30 and minimum 10. What is its amplitude?
Hints: Amplitude is half the total range.|Compute (30-10)/2.
Solution: The full output range runs from 10 to 30. Amplitude is half its width: (30-10)/2=10. The midline is the average: (30+10)/2=20. Thus the requested amplitude is 10, in the same output units as the extremes.

Solution: The period is the time for one complete cycle before the pattern repeats. The stated repeat time is 24 hours, so the period is 24 hours.

Question Choices: A sinusoidal model has least positive period 12 months. Find the positive coefficient B in sin(Bt), with t in months and Bt in radians.
Solution: Use positive B and radian angles. Over one least positive period, B(12)=2pi, so B=2pi/12=pi/6 radians per month. Check that 2pi/B recovers the given period.
